model.name: Task 30.25: Picking a RIGHT ref preserves the LEFT side (no blanking)
model.description: Fix the left-empties-on-right-select bug: picking a branch on the RIGHT pane must NOT blank the LEFT. TRON invariant — a RIGHT pick touches ONLY right+center, NEVER left. A symmetric _rightUserPicked guard (mirrors _leftUserPicked) makes a user-driven RIGHT win over the auto-promote so populateLeftHistory does not replace this.right nor run its default left-reload; the promote is serialized (await + generation token) so a stale promote's left-reload tail aborts on token mismatch.
model.intention: S30 diff/merge editor regression (R30.25, Tron): open a working file (auto-promote older-on-left) then pick a RIGHT branch → LEFT was blanking. Restore left-identity under right-pick, including the race window (pick RIGHT while promote in flight).
